lines: Thanks for the proposal. The quality looks great, but the price is above our budget.
I understand. What price did you have in mind?
We were hoping for a fifteen percent discount.
Fifteen percent might be a bit difficult for us. Would you be open to ten percent with a two-year contract?
Hmm, let's meet halfway. Twelve percent, and we'll sign for two years.
I think we can work with that. I'll send the revised proposal tomorrow.
listen.dict: What price did you have in mind?

read.title: Re: Revised Proposal
read.text:
Dear Mr. Park,

Thank you for your quick response. We have reviewed your request and are happy to offer a 12 percent discount on the annual contract, as discussed on our call.

In return, we would ask that payment be made within 30 days of each invoice. We can also be flexible on the delivery schedule: shipments can be monthly or every two weeks, depending on your needs.

Please let us know which option you prefer, and we will prepare the final contract.

Kind regards,
Laura Kim

write.task: 거래처가 보낸 견적이 예산보다 높아요. 정중하게 가격 조정을 요청하는 이메일을 써 보세요.
write.en: The supplier's quote is above your budget. Write a polite email asking them to adjust the price.
write.model:
Dear Ms. Kim,

Thank you for sending the proposal. We really like the quality of your products, but the price is a bit above our budget for this year. Would you be open to a 10 percent discount if we sign a two-year contract? We are flexible on the delivery schedule as well.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
